name: async-pr-review
summary: 据技能文档，可在 Gemini CLI 中请求审查当前 Git 项目的拉取请求。可复用脚本会在后台运行预检、执行由 Gemini 驱动的测试计划，并生成代码审查结果。该流程需要以无界面模式运行 `gemini` 命令，并使用临时 Git 工作树，避免改动主工作区。

The skill’s documentation says you can ask Gemini CLI to review a pull request in the current Git project. Reusable scripts run preflight checks, execute Gemini-powered test plans, and produce a code review in the background. The workflow requires the `gemini` executable in headless mode and uses a temporary Git worktree to keep the main checkout undisturbed.
